text: Source-confirmed factor-policy slice implemented: FactorLevelSet/FactorLevelRegistry provide stable declared order; Event.factorWithLevels rejects unknown observations before convolution; integer/double-coded columns can be explicitly categorical; EmptyCellPolicy supports compatibility, Omit, RetainZero, and Reject; factor-level/empty-cell evidence enters DesignAudit and fingerprints. Public parity tests cover stable order, row permutation, unknown levels, duplicate declarations, numeric factors, retained zero cells, and typed empty-cell rejection. EventModelBuilderParitySuite passes 23/23 JVM and 23/23 JS; full design passes 175/175 JVM and 175/175 JS; model 19/19 JVM+JS; fit 172/172 JVM and 164/164 JS. P2.1 remains open for cross-run/subject schema binding, richer retained/omitted cell receipts, and broader public S08/S09 scenarios.
